programme.title: PWA World Cup - Tiberias, Israel
programme.desc: Athletes are meeting in Tiberias, Israel, for the PWA World Cup. This first leg of this year's competition will be filled with action after 18 months of inactivity. With winds between 18 and 30 knots, it will truly be a challenge for the world's best windsurf sailors and with this uncertainty in the conditions, we can expect anything to happen in Israel. Don't miss out on the PWA World Cup 2021 in Tiberias that marks the beginning of this year's windsurfing action!

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 10
programme.desc: On this ocassion we travel to the Swiss Alps, concretely to the Engadin Valley. The upper part of the valley, at around 1800m is a magical place for tourism and both winter and summer sports. Vanora ENGADINWIND by Dakine, is one of the most famous watersports events in the world: a unique windsurfing festival that includes freestyle action.Then, we will head to Italy’s Genoa in order to focus on L30 class following the 2020 EUROSAF Mixed Offshore European Championships. Some of the continent’s best sailors put in their best performances in a bid for the title and we were there to capture all of the action.

programme.title: 52 Super Series - Ep.2 - Rolex TP52 World Championship Porto Cervo 2026
Atlantic Cup - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome back to this edition of the Atlantic Cup. It is time for the third and final leg of the competition, the inshore series. Dragon and Gryphon Solo 2 are tied for, and teams have added 4 extra crew, allowing them to push their boats around the tight courses in Naragannset Bay. Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez - 20 Years Of Les Voiles De St Tropez
programme.desc: Join Nautical Channel for a full coverage of one of the most awaited nautical events in the world. We will bring you to the most exclusive events and have special insights with the best athletes and all the VIPs. We will show you what it feels like to be on board on an ultra-modern super yacht during a match race in the legendary bay of Brigitte Bardot and also take a look around inside some of the most amazing classic yachts that ever sailed.

Salon Nautique Paris - 2013

Inside Superyachts - Episode 3
programme.desc: Speed is the name of the game in this episode as we visit Dutch shipyard Heesen Yachts, renowned builder of record breaking, fast, lightweight aluminium superyachts. We talk to naval architects ‘Omega’ and we get an onboard look at the racing colour design of M/Y Aurelia, designed by Bannenberg & Rowell. Finally, no yacht would be complete without the latest technology and fastest onboard gadgets. We discover just what’s hot on a yacht with the most sought-after tech and AV firm, IdeaWorks.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show - Episode 8
programme.desc: In this episode 8 of Maxiboat, we dive into the world of ocean racing and the Ultimates category with these real F1 boats that distinguished themselves in the last Transat Jacques Vabre. Then we visit the Prestige Yachts in Vendée, France, to discover the X Line series and especially the brand new X60, a French motor-yacht in the era of time. Back to the Cannes Yachting Festival, we try out two brands in the spotlight: the Turkish shipyard Sirena Marine and its brand new Sirena 68 and then Zeelander, another high-end lobster brand from the Netherlands. Come on board with us!

programme.title: Behind The Scenes - Karujet World Championship
programme.desc: The much awaited 19th edition of the Karujet has finally roared through the island of Guadeloupe. With the world's top guns of Jet Ski racing on the pitch, these daredevils ploughed through waves at speeds of up to 80 knots.To bring this event to life, people from all over the world join to create what is becoming the biggest nautical event for Jet Ski lovers of the year. As competitors speed across the ocean, firm land spectators await in an exciting celebration. Who will become this year’s champion? Watch as Nautical Channel goes behind the scenes to interview the crazy brave competitors as we explore what it takes to fuel such a big event in the Caribbean island of Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Ride to the Roots - Adriano de Souza
Brilliant Corners Barbados
programme.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Barbados while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Barbados: an eastern Caribbean island with colonial buildings, botanical gardens and 17th century plantation houses. Join Sam Bleakly, a travel writer, surfer, and a lecturer in cultural tourism, as he takes you under the skin of the coastline and inner parts of Barbados.

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 1
programme.desc: Andi is on a mission to discover the Tana River, Kenya’s longest river with a unique rapids system. In order to truly experience this region of the Tana, Andi has to learn to navigate the waters on a kayak. She tracks down river expert and professional Kayaker Kris Collyer and challenges him to learn his skill in three days. Andi is tested when she almost drowns trying to complete her mission.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3
programme.desc: In this new episode of Sail-Ho Croatia, we explore the Markaska Riviera. This area is best known for its beautiful natural beaches and amazing gastronomic delights. Makarska is the center of the Markaska riviera, and it is a hub of culture, education and tourism. Let's discover it!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! The city of Split was formed around the Roman Emperor Diocletian's Palace, and this was built as his retirement residence. However, we have certainly found it as one of the most exciting, fun and action-packed places in the Adriatic. Let's catch up on Split's action!

programme.title: Chef On Board - Episode 5
programme.desc: Lapo is back on land for the Surf and Turf Season finale. He will be meeting the Tuscan Cowboys to learn about Tuscany’s beef industry as well as taking to the waters with a local fisherman to fish for sea urchins. On this final episode, Lapo is ready to give his all and prove himself worthy of his captain's approval. Will the Captain finally soften to Lapo?

programme.title: Skeleton Sea
programme.desc: João and Xandi, two surfers in their early 50′s, have been working together for 25 years. They clean beaches and with the trash they pick they create the most stunning artwork. However, living as an artist and idealist in Portugal is not economically profitable and, therefore, not easy.Their family life is affected by the choices they make and their wish to raise awareness about the ever-growing pollution in our oceans. Skeleton Sea takes us on their personal journey to help people understand the importance of our oceans to help us take the step to change our habits to keep them clean. As all live comes from the sea, Skeleton Sea reminds us that this powerful force has the ability of taking it away from us as well.

programme.title: Dusi Canoe Marathon - Episode 1
programme.desc: Join host Andi van Zyl in South Africa for one of the toughest canoe races in the world! Are you ready for all its action? Discover the 2014 Dusi Canoe Marathon on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 5
programme.desc: From big and energetic cities to beautiful small villages, Quebec has it all. A stunning coastline and amazing food, but more than anything else, pristine wilderness. The Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean region boasts three national parks and a dramatic Saguenay Fjord. This time, Ken Whiting will tackle one of Eastern Canada's most popular whitewater rivers.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 6
programme.desc: Montreal is a historic and multicultural place that pulses with energy. What makes it particularly amazing is that it also provides easy access to outdoor activities and world-class paddling opportunities, both inside and outside city limits. The Eastern Townships are known for their charming villages, incredible food and beautiful waterways. This week we are exploring them and Montreal.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 1 World Cup Lee Valley
programme.desc: Welcome to the Lee Valley White Water Centre just outside London for the World Cup 1 of the ICF Canoe Slalom. We will be talking you through the action of this competition: it is going to be canoe single men followed by the kayak single women. Follow us for slalom competition at its highest level. Relive the best moments in Lee Valley 2019.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 2 World Cup Bratislava
programme.desc: Welcome to Bratislava, in Slovakia, for round two of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. Mallory Franklin, Kimberley Woods and Jessica Fox were the top three in Lee Valley last weekend, however Mallory Franklin and Kimberley Woods will not be racing this weekend while Jessica Fox got eliminated in the semi-final. In the C1 men's the medalists from last weekend will also not be racing here, but there are some big names in the lineup. Let's dive into the action in Bratislava.

Don’t miss all the action, the disappointments and victories at the start of what will be an epic African series.

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa - Episode 2 - Port Alfred Classic
programme.desc: Welcome to the second event of the South Africa WQS Surf Series. This time, we are in Port Alfred at The Royal St Andrews Hotel Port Alfred Classic. Some of South Africa's best waves can be surfed here despite also being one of the most underrated locations. We are in for a thrill!

programme.title: International Surfing Association World Championship - World Adaptive Surfing Championship
programme.desc: This year’s anticipated 2017 ISA World Adaptive Surfing Championship will be held in sunny San Diego in the renown La Jolla neighborhood. With various events and a large following, the Championship is a fun and unique experience; both for the surfers and its spectators.

programme.title: The Women and the Waves - Part 2
programme.desc: The Women and the Waves 2 is a documentary surf film that celebrates women and their unique approach to surfing and life. The film looks at the state of surfing today from a feminine perspective and features positive role models that give back to people and the planet. Following in the footsteps of the groundbreaking 2009 film, The Women and The Waves Part 2 continues to explore the culture of surfing in relation to six surfers and their lives both in and out of the water.

programme.title: RORC Caribbean 600
programme.desc: The RORC Caribbean 600 is an exciting 600-mile offshore race that takes competitors around some of the most beautiful islands of the Caribbean. In its 12th edition, more than 73 boats from 22 countries joined in a competition with participants from over 37 different nationalities.The fleet is made up not only of professional sailors and their boats, but also with Corinthian amateurs that love this offshore race. As it is the only offshore race in the Caribbean, it gets the attention of the best sailors worldwide. The race starts and finishes in Antigua and weaves its way around 11 different islands including St. Maarten and Guadaloupe amongst them.Be part of this unique race across the Caribbean with Nautical Channel and find out what crew will raise with victory.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 11
programme.desc: In this month’s episode we will start our journey at Lake Traunsee in Austria following the 2020 Formula Kite Mixed Team Relay European Championships. Next, we travel to Greece in order to follow an inaugural regatta for traditional boats, Oceanida, organized by Attica Region and Nautical Club 78.After that, we are going to have a closer look to one of the oldest Olympic boats, the 470 class and focus on the Dutch 470 sailor Afrodite Zegers.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 5
programme.desc: Emirates Team New Zealand take Bermuda by storm as Peter Burling knocks out James Spithill in the first four races. Now, it's an uphill battle for Oracle Team USA at the 35th America's Cup. On the tech specs, we unveil the secrets of speed and why Team New Zealand has delivered a better overall package on their powerful AC50 'Aoateroa'. Watch the full recap of the AC35 kickoff.

programme.title: Heineken Regatta - Episode 1
programme.desc: The St. Maarten Heineken Regatta celebrates its 33th edition! This year, the Regatta Organization has overworked to design challenging courses and guarantee smooth sailing. Moreover, Heineken brings all the awesome music and a four-day party atmosphere considered unmissable by many. Relive the best moments of the 2013 Heineken Regatta!

programme.title: Clipper: The Race Of Their Lives - Episode 2
programme.desc: The Clipper Race crews are in Uruguay and celebrate a wonderful visit with a spectacular send-off. One crew has suffered a dramatic incident in the middle of the night, and there is a tragedy that will affect everyone involved in the race. Find out now how the challengers will overcome their obstacles in one of the toughest nautical competitions around the globe.

programme.title: RORC Caribbean 600

programme.title: Sails In Sardinia
programme.desc: Sails in Sardinia takes us to the beautiful Italian island of Sardinia, the sescond largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, to visit the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda, in Porto Cervo. We are meeting Ricardo Bonadeo, Commodore of the yacht club, to understand better how the 1967 non-profit organization has become today a world's leading organizer in international sailing events. Join Andi Van Zyl as she heads to the beautiful Costa Smeralda and interviews other big sailing personalities as Francesco Bruni and Terry Hutchinson, on Sails in Sardinia.

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep9
Salon Nautique Paris - 2014
programme.desc: The annual event to discover the nautical novelties of the coming season. A showcase of close to 785 exhibitors and 1,300 brands for an attendance of over 240,000 visitors, 1200 boats on display including nearly 200 new features!

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Episode 6 - Biograd Region
Inside Superyachts - Episode 4
programme.desc: Italians are known for their quality and style, and their superyachts are no different. Undoubtedly the largest and most famous of Italian builders is Perini Navi, makers of one of the most ecologically friendly superyachts in the world, the Maltese Falcon. We meet with designer Ken Frievokh and engineer Damon Roberts to understand the technology behind their ground-breaking dyna-rig onboard the Maltese Falcon.We then take a look at some of the finest Italian boats built by one of the fastest growing shipyards: Mondomarine. We get an all access introduction to Viareggio’s Sealyon, whose opulent and glamorous interiors were designed by Martin Kemp at Candy & Candy.

programme.title: Gulf of Mexico
programme.desc: Beppe Faresin is an extreme kayaker with a dream: venturing into the Gulf of Mexico on a kayak. In this adventure, he will kayak his way through the Mexican lagoons and swamps to discover the wild nature of this unique country. Faresin is already famous for raising funds for UNICEF while paddling in rivers and oceans all over the world. Now, he faces a new challenge: crossing the Gulf of Mexico by himself. For almost 1500 km, this apparently fearless athlete will discover corners of Mexico otherwise unreachable by land. Follow his challenge navigating through the Gulf and find out what happens along the way.

programme.title: Surf's Cooking
programme.desc: Matt Bromley is a renowned big wave surfer. Ollie Swart is a chef. Together, the two best friends will embark on an adventure down Cape Town’s coastline. Foraging for food and looking for the best surf spots, Surf’s Cooking brings gastronomy to the surfing world with this beautiful friendship.Both friends will have to quickly adapt and learn about each other. For Matt Bromley, learning about foraging for food and how to cook it properly will become challenging, and Ollie Swart will have to surf past the obstacles in this nautical sport. Will they be ready to share their passion between them?Watch their adventure in South Africa on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode, Andi will discover the diverse marine ecosystem of Kilifi Creek. She will learn how to sail in three days in order to truly experience the creek. Andi goes 3 degrees south to meet Kevin, a local sailor who patiently teaches Andi the skills she needs in this short span of time. A true local experience is waiting if she can complete her training but failure is always lurking.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5
programme.desc: One of the many charms of the island of Vis lies in its 500 years long isolation as a military island. Vis has an unspoiled nature, magical beaches and the hospitality of its people is so authentic it will make you want to stay in this place forever. In this episode of Sail-Ho, we will be exploring this charming island.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6
programme.desc: Hello sailors! In this episode we will be island hopping the Zadar archipelago. We will visit the islands of Ugljan, Pašman and Pag, and our first stop will be the Ugljan, also known as the Olive Island. This is one of the most picturesque islands of the entire archipelago, so it will be a great start.

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of Road to Bermuda we meet the man who decided to take the America's Cup to Bermuda and explore some of sailing's most complex challenges. Also, the famous skipper Jimmy Spithill will share his experience on the island with us. Watch this and more on The Road to Bermuda!

programme.title: SXM Best Weekend
programme.desc: Ready for the best weekend of your lives? The SXM Best Weekend is one of the most anticipated Caribbean summer events of the year. A local group of young brothers and musicians called “The Red Eye Crew” decided to revolutionize the party scenario in these paradisiac islands. That is why they brought a party wave onto St. Maarten.Follow their crazy adventure as they organize this explosive event and share their inspiring story on how they came up with this idea and what drives them. A fun journey for party lovers, SXM Best Weekend will have you put your hands up and enjoy the queens of Caribbean music with blasting performances from Haitian rapper Wyclef Jean.Party your way around the Caribbean rhythm, on Nautical Channel.

We meet with designer Ken Frievokh and engineer Damon Roberts to understand the technology behind their ground-breaking dyna-rig onboard the Maltese Falcon.We then take a look at some of the finest Italian boats built by one of the fastest growing shipyards: Mondomarine. We get an all access introduction to Viareggio’s Sealyon, whose opulent and glamorous interiors were designed by Martin Kemp at Candy & Candy.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 5
programme.desc: From big and energetic cities to beautiful small villages, Quebec has it all. A stunning coastline and amazing food, but more than anything else, pristine wilderness. The Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean region boasts three national parks and a dramatic Saguenay Fjord. This time, Ken Whiting will tackle one of Eastern Canada's most popular whitewater rivers.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 6
programme.desc: Montreal is a historic and multicultural place that pulses with energy. What makes it particularly amazing is that it also provides easy access to outdoor activities and world-class paddling opportunities, both inside and outside city limits. The Eastern Townships are known for their charming villages, incredible food and beautiful waterways. This week we are exploring them and Montreal.

programme.title: Dusi Canoe Marathon - Episode 1
programme.desc: One of the most physically testing competitions is coming soon to Nautical Channel. The Dusi Canoe Marathon is a one of a kind canoe and running endurance race set in the magnificent South African Drakensberg hills and rapids. Follow this years edition as some of the fittest men and women single handedly row the 120 km river and run over the hills carrying their custom built canoes over their shoulders. Who will come first in this prestigious African event?

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 3 World Cup Tacen
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 4 World Cup Markkleeberg
programme.desc: We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup. As we are a month away from the olympic qualifiers and World Championships in Spain, we are ready for a sharp end of the 2019 international racing season. Discover the best moments in Markkleeberg on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 14

The physically challenged surfers participate in teams of up to eight members, and represent their home countries as they race through the waters. With various events and a large following, the Championship is a fun and unique experience; both for the surfers and its spectators.

programme.title: Azores European Windsurf Cup 2013
programme.desc: Formula Windsurfing Junior Youth & Masters European Championship - The Euro Cup 2013 was held in the stunning Azores archipelago. Be part of the race, meet the stars of the “Formula” world, get to know young aspiring talents and experience this exciting competition in this unique location in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean!

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 5
programme.desc: Emirates Team New Zealand take Bermuda by storm as Peter Burling knocks out James Spithill in the first four races. Now, it's an uphill battle for Oracle Team USA at the 35th America's Cup. On the tech specs, we unveil the secrets of speed and why Team New Zealand has delivered a better overall package on their powerful AC50 'Aoateroa'. Watch the full recap of the AC35 kickoff.

programme.title: Heineken Regatta - Episode 1
programme.desc: The St. Maarten Heineken Regatta celebrates its 33th edition! This year, the Regatta Organization has overworked to design challenging courses and guarantee smooth sailing. Moreover, Heineken brings all the awesome music and a four-day party atmosphere considered unmissable by many. Relive the best moments of the 2013 Heineken Regatta!

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 7
programme.desc: Poland is a place of immense historical significant that goes back more than a thousand years. Although it is well known for its role in the Second World War, Poland is also being appreciated for its world class cuisine, breathtaking countryside and ease of travel. This week on Facing Waves, we are set to discover the beautiful waterways of Poland.

programme.title: Sails In Sardinia
programme.desc: Sails in Sardinia takes us to the beautiful Italian island of Sardinia, the sescond largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, to visit the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda, in Porto Cervo. Known for being visited by the rich and famous, it also has a unique sailing history. We will get the true essence of competitive sailing at the Audi Settimana Delle Bocche, where the last leg of the TP52 Super Series is being held. We are meeting Ricardo Bonadeo, Commodore of the yacht club, to understand better how the 1967 non-profit organization has become today a world's leading organizer in international sailing events. Join Andi Van Zyl as she heads to the beautiful Costa Smeralda and interviews other big sailing personalities as Francesco Bruni and Terry Hutchinson, on Sails in Sardinia.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode we’ll be flying back to Europe, to watch the 2019 Formula Kite European Championships in Italy. Taking place in the Mediterranean track, Oristano Gulf welcomes kiteboarding in an event that will be as plastic free as possible. For all the athletes from the 22 countries participating, anticipation is high as this is the 4th major event for athletes in less than two months.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: The last stop takes place on the magnificent island of Sardinia and the city of Cagliari. This is the third successive year that the Sardinian capital of Cagliari has hosted the series, where intense battles in the cutting-edge kiteboarding discipline will again be fought out on the Gulf of Angels off the pristine Poetto Beach.

programme.title: RORC Caribbean 600
programme.desc: The RORC Caribbean 600 is an exciting 600-mile offshore race that takes competitors around some of the most beautiful islands of the Caribbean. In its 12th edition, more than 73 boats from 22 countries joined in a competition with participants from over 37 different nationalities.The fleet is made up not only of professional sailors and their boats, but also with Corinthian amateurs that love this offshore race. As it is the only offshore race in the Caribbean, it gets the attention of the best sailors worldwide. The race starts and finishes in Antigua and weaves its way around 11 different islands including St. Maarten and Guadaloupe amongst them.Be part of this unique race across the Caribbean with Nautical Channel and find out what crew will raise with victory.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP of Qatar (Ski GP & Ski Ladies GP)
Sail-Ho - Episode 5
programme.desc: One of the many charms of the island of Vis lies in its 500 years long isolation as a military island. Vis has an unspoiled nature, magical beaches and the hospitality of its people is so authentic it will make you want to stay in this place forever. In this episode of Sail-Ho, we will be exploring this charming island.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6
programme.desc: Hello sailors! In this episode we will be island hopping the Zadar archipelago. We will visit the islands of Ugljan, Pašman and Pag, and our first stop will be the Ugljan, also known as the Olive Island. This is one of the most picturesque islands of the entire archipelago, so it will be a great start.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Episode 6 - Biograd Region
Inside Superyachts - Episode 4
programme.desc: Italians are known for their quality and style, and their superyachts are no different. Undoubtedly the largest and most famous of Italian builders is Perini Navi, makers of one of the most ecologically friendly superyachts in the world, the Maltese Falcon. We meet with designer Ken Frievokh and engineer Damon Roberts to understand the technology behind their ground-breaking dyna-rig onboard the Maltese Falcon.We then take a look at some of the finest Italian boats built by one of the fastest growing shipyards: Mondomarine. We get an all access introduction to Viareggio’s Sealyon, whose opulent and glamorous interiors were designed by Martin Kemp at Candy & Candy.

programme.title: P1 USA AquaX - Episode 7 - Review Part One
Up the Creek
programme.desc: There's only one boat race in the world where two-man teams blast up southern Australia's Murray River in aluminium dinghies at speeds of over 80kph. This river is not only known for dividing Victoria from New South Wales and for being Australia’s longest river, but also for being full of dangerous obstacles.Up the Creek challenges competing teams to speed up Murray River’s challenging water in a competition like no other. Find out now what will happen in this competition that explores Australia’s nature in depth, on Nautical Channel.

Surf Series: South Africa - Episode 3 - SA Open
programme.desc: The penultimate event of the South African Surf Series takes place at Pollock Beach. This is one of the highlights of the WSL Africa tour and features a Women’s QS 3000, Men’s QS 1000 and Junior Men and Women’s QS 1000 rated events. With a field of top international and local surfers, this event is bound to heat up as the best South African Surfers face off some formidable opponents. Fierce competition may see some position changes ahead of the final event of the series.

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa - Episode 4 - Vic Bay
programme.desc: The Vic Bay Classic takes place in the winter months so expect the biggest swells and highest quality of surfing. Watch former CT contender fight for the win as the crowd cheers their local hero. The fight for the mens series winner gets even closer at this final event. Who will claim victory and take the overall series winnings in the season finale of the City Surf Series?

programme.title: Paddling across Borders
programme.desc: Our expedition begins in the Klopeinersee, a journey that leads us into two countries - Slovenia and Austria. We're going to meet people whom the cold, fog and snow in winter does not keep them away from spending every day at the water. The Klopeinersee has many opportunities to get active in the water. We will dive into a unique location in Europe, the 2125 metre-high Petzen mountain, to do watersports! Join Nautical Channel's hosts Lucia Metzbauer as she meets locals on both sides of the boarder who are crazy about their boats even in sub-zero temperatures, above and below the ground. We are going Paddling across Borders!

Known for being visited by the rich and famous, it also has a unique sailing history. We will get the true essence of competitive sailing at the Audi Settimana Delle Bocche, where the last leg of the TP52 Super Series is being held. We are meeting Ricardo Bonadeo, Commodore of the yacht club, to understand better how the 1967 non-profit organization has become today a world's leading organizer in international sailing events. Join Andi Van Zyl as she heads to the beautiful Costa Smeralda and interviews other big sailing personalities as Francesco Bruni and Terry Hutchinson, on Sails in Sardinia.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 6 - GP of China - Shangai
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP of Italy (Puglia)
RORC Caribbean 600
programme.desc: The RORC Caribbean 600 is an exciting 600-mile offshore race that takes competitors around some of the most beautiful islands of the Caribbean. In its 12th edition, more than 73 boats from 22 countries joined in a competition with participants from over 37 different nationalities.The fleet is made up not only of professional sailors and their boats, but also with Corinthian amateurs that love this offshore race. As it is the only offshore race in the Caribbean, it gets the attention of the best sailors worldwide. The race starts and finishes in Antigua and weaves its way around 11 different islands including St. Maarten and Guadaloupe amongst them.Be part of this unique race across the Caribbean with Nautical Channel and find out what crew will raise with victory.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 7
programme.desc: Poland is a place of immense historical significant that goes back more than a thousand years. Although it is well known for its role in the Second World War, Poland is also being appreciated for its world class cuisine, breathtaking countryside and ease of travel. This week on Facing Waves, we are set to discover the beautiful waterways of Poland.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5
programme.desc: One of the many charms of the island of Vis lies in its 500 years long isolation as a military island. Vis has an unspoiled nature, magical beaches and the hospitality of its people is so authentic it will make you want to stay in this place forever. In this episode of Sail-Ho, we will be exploring this charming island.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6
programme.desc: Hello sailors! In this episode we will be island hopping the Zadar archipelago. We will visit the islands of Ugljan, Pašman and Pag, and our first stop will be the Ugljan, also known as the Olive Island. This is one of the most picturesque islands of the entire archipelago, so it will be a great start.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Episode 6 - Biograd Region
Inside Superyachts - Episode 4
programme.desc: Italians are known for their quality and style, and their superyachts are no different. Undoubtedly the largest and most famous of Italian builders is Perini Navi, makers of one of the most ecologically friendly superyachts in the world, the Maltese Falcon. We meet with designer Ken Frievokh and engineer Damon Roberts to understand the technology behind their ground-breaking dyna-rig onboard the Maltese Falcon.We then take a look at some of the finest Italian boats built by one of the fastest growing shipyards: Mondomarine. We get an all access introduction to Viareggio’s Sealyon, whose opulent and glamorous interiors were designed by Martin Kemp at Candy & Candy.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 5
programme.desc: Emirates Team New Zealand take Bermuda by storm as Peter Burling knocks out James Spithill in the first four races. Now, it's an uphill battle for Oracle Team USA at the 35th America's Cup. On the tech specs, we unveil the secrets of speed and why Team New Zealand has delivered a better overall package on their powerful AC50 'Aoateroa'. Watch the full recap of the AC35 kickoff.

programme.title: Heineken Regatta - Episode 1
programme.desc: The St. Maarten Heineken Regatta celebrates its 33th edition! This year, the Regatta Organization has overworked to design challenging courses and guarantee smooth sailing. Moreover, Heineken brings all the awesome music and a four-day party atmosphere considered unmissable by many. Relive the best moments of the 2013 Heineken Regatta!

programme.title: Sail For Surf
programme.desc: Collin Martins is a French chef with only one goal in mind: surfing. His passion started when he was just 3 years old. This was when his parents got him on a surfboard for the first time in Cap Ferret. It often starts like this. However, Collin’s course and his passion for surfing took a really atypical and unique turn.Looking for the best waves around the world, he decides to step into the unknown in 2017 and become autonomous living on a sailboat. From here he patiently studies the weather conditions, direction of the swell and tides to predict where the best waves will appear in order to surf them. Without any previous knowledge in the field, he carried out a professional training of marine navigation, bought a sailboat and took as headland Indonesia.Follow his exhilarating journey on his sailboat as he blends in Indonesian culture while catching the best waves.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 12
programme.desc: This is the last episode for 2020, so we have recollected the best action in Austria. At Lake Attersee the 2020 Forward WIP 49er, 49erFX & Nacra 17 European Championships are taking place, and the fastest Olympic classes have been tested to their limites in this event.Next, we move to Portoroz in Slovenia for the 2020 Optimist European Championships. More than two hundred sailors across five different categories have gathered to compete, and we are ready for top-leveled sailing. Finally, we head to China and the Shanghai Yacht Club for a world class youth sailing competition.

programme.title: Sofia
programme.desc: Sofía is a short documentary film about the life of young surfer Sofía De Tomás, Canary Islands’ surf champion. Originally from La Orotava, Tenerife, Sofia tells us through interviews and cinematic shoots about her surfing lifestyle and what inclined her towards the surf world.Sofia balances her time between painting and surfing, and for her painting has a similar effect sometimes as surfing. However, for Sofia, surfing is a sport that traps you, and once you start it, you can’t stop, you want more. It’s something she can’t live without.Live the beauty of the Canary Islands in this short documentary film about this young talent in the surf world. Sofia offers beautiful scenery, heart-warming moments and a strong desire to get on a board yourself and start surfing the world.

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep9
Salon Nautique Paris - 2015
programme.desc: Among the world's greatest boat shows, Salon Nautique in Paris is back! Join Nico Peduzzi at the prestigious Port de Versailles and discover this year's hottest innovations in sailing, motorboats, board sports, equipment, tourism and more.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts - Episode 5
programme.desc: Arguably, a superyacht is the most glamorous holiday you can take. Burgess yachts, the largest yacht broker in the world, talks to us about the process of owning and/or chartering your very own yacht.We take a look at just how yachts are marketed and meet with Australian Shipbuilders Silver Yachts, who achieved the amazing feat of getting a Mercedes car onto their Yacht Silver Fast for one of the most epic yachts commercials ever.For those wanting more than a charter, but don’t want to own a boat outright, we introduce them to MAHA Yachts, a brand new concept bridging the gap between Charter and Sales – a unique collaboration with the world leading hotelier Adrian Zecha from Aman Hotels and Feadship.We sign off with one last adventure underwater, exploring the sea with Deep Flight and Rainbow Fish, interviewing Dr. Xin Wu who is helping to pioneer deep water tourism.

programme.title: MAR
programme.desc: Surfing has ceased a long time ago to be considered a niche sport. As the mainstream industry discovers its potential for selling clothes, trips and a whole set of ‘lifestyle’ products, there are those who appreciate it for what it is in its purest form – a direct connection to mother nature.We accompany Big Wave surfer Alex Botelho and some of his friends to meet surfers who balance their love for the ocean and nature with a professional career in the sport. Mar is a tale of discovery, triumph and (almost) tragedy, but above all it is a life affirming pledge to positive vibes in and out of the line-up.Get ready to soak up a new conception of the world of surf as Alex Botelho unveils concepts unknown for the mainstream audience, available on Nautical Channel.Awards:Best Feature Documentary – Best Istanbul Film Festival 2021. Official Selections 2021: Ocean Film Festival World Tour, International Ocean Film Festival.

programme.desc: Collin Martins is a French chef with only one goal in mind: surfing. His passion started when he was just 3 years old. This was when his parents got him on a surfboard for the first time in Cap Ferret. It often starts like this. However, Collin’s course and his passion for surfing took a really atypical and unique turn.Looking for the best waves around the world, he decides to step into the unknown in 2017 and become autonomous living on a sailboat. From here he patiently studies the weather conditions, direction of the swell and tides to predict where the best waves will appear in order to surf them. programme.title: Sofia

programme.desc: Arguably, a superyacht is the most glamorous holiday you can take. programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 7
programme.desc: Poland is a place of immense historical significant that goes back more than a thousand years. Although it is well known for its role in the Second World War, Poland is also being appreciated for its world class cuisine, breathtaking countryside and ease of travel. This week on Facing Waves, we are set to discover the beautiful waterways of Poland.

Burgess yachts, the largest yacht broker in the world, talks to us about the process of owning and/or chartering your very own yacht.We take a look at just how yachts are marketed and meet with Australian Shipbuilders Silver Yachts, who achieved the amazing feat of getting a Mercedes car onto their Yacht Silver Fast for one of the most epic yachts commercials ever.For those wanting more than a charter, but don’t want to own a boat outright, we introduce them to MAHA Yachts, a brand new concept bridging the gap between Charter and Sales – a unique collaboration with the world leading hotelier Adrian Zecha from Aman Hotels and Feadship.We sign off with one last adventure underwater, exploring the sea with Deep Flight and Rainbow Fish, interviewing Dr. Xin Wu who is helping to pioneer deep water tourism.

programme.title: ISA World Jr Surfing Championship - Episode 1 - El Salvador
Azores Windsurf Championship 2014
programme.desc: Formula Windsurfing Junior Youth & Masters European Championship - The Euro Cup 2014 was held in the stunningly beautiful Azores.

programme.title: Sofia
programme.desc: Sofía is a short documentary film about the life of young surfer Sofía De Tomás, Canary Islands’ surf champion. Originally from La Orotava, Tenerife, Sofia tells us through interviews and cinematic shoots about her surfing lifestyle and what inclined her towards the surf world.Sofia balances her time between painting and surfing, and for her painting has a similar effect sometimes as surfing. However, for Sofia, surfing is a sport that traps you, and once you start it, you can’t stop, you want more. It’s something she can’t live without.Live the beauty of the Canary Islands in this short documentary film about this young talent in the surf world. Sofia offers beautiful scenery, heart-warming moments and a strong desire to get on a board yourself and start surfing the world.

programme.title: Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour Magazines - Episode 2
Heineken Regatta - Episode 1
programme.desc: Boasting world class competition and legendary parties, the St. Maarten Heineken Regatta reigns as the undisputed king of Caribbean sailing. Given the lineup of over 200 internationally acclaimed boats skippered by the sailing world's top athletes, the stakes are high and anything can happen.Sail with us across the highlights of the 34th edition of the Heineken Regatta!

programme.title: Sail For Surf
programme.desc: Collin Martins is a French chef with only one goal in mind: surfing. His passion started when he was just 3 years old. This was when his parents got him on a surfboard for the first time in Cap Ferret. It often starts like this. However, Collin’s course and his passion for surfing took a really atypical and unique turn.Looking for the best waves around the world, he decides to step into the unknown in 2017 and become autonomous living on a sailboat. From here he patiently studies the weather conditions, direction of the swell and tides to predict where the best waves will appear in order to surf them. Without any previous knowledge in the field, he carried out a professional training of marine navigation, bought a sailboat and took as headland Indonesia.Follow his exhilarating journey on his sailboat as he blends in Indonesian culture while catching the best waves.

programme.title: Kino in Bali
programme.desc: Come with Kino as she explores magical Bali in the latest installment of Global Yogi. This place is a mecca for yoga, healing, surfing and is known for its welcoming and peaceful Balinese culture. Here it’s common to discover a feeling of being safe and sound, and that was certainly the case for Kino. Green juice, island sand, coconuts and temples… the intoxicating energy of the island spirit can be found around every corner. Days are easily spent relaxing and and enjoying waves and sunsets. Check in for a massage, roll out your mat for practice, chat with the charming locals and find the perfect spot for a quiet meditation… All this and more as Kino continues to bring her message of insight and transformation to the world.

programme.title: Leaning into Forward Folds
programme.desc: This session is all about sitting with the hamstrings and forward bends in a state of equanimity. Join Kino as she leads you on a journey to healing. Learn to sit with your discomfort and begin to uncover and understand the intelligent messages that come from within. 25 minutes

programme.title: Paschimottanasana
programme.desc: Begin with awareness of breath and body sensation in this gentle yoga class. You will find yourself present and relaxed by the end of this forward folding focused sequence.

programme.title: Meditation Now - Sharpen the Mind
programme.desc: Find a comfortable seat, close your eyes and imagine yourself sitting in the warm sand on a beautiful beach as you join Kino for today’s meditation. Sharpen the edge of the mind as you bring your awareness to a single point of focus.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meditation for Kapha

programme.title: Standing Postures

programme.title: Yoga Is Patience
programme.desc: For many of us, patience does not come naturally. this class brings us an opportunity to understand patience through the twisting posture Marichasana C. Join Kino as she guides you into embodiment through breath awareness and gentle movement. Be patient and kind with your body as you move into the practice and a deeper twist through the spinal axis.

programme.title: Yoga Is Stillness
programme.desc: One of the key lessons of yoga is stillness, known as Nirodaha in Sanskrit. We will use the headstand position to practice approaching situations with calm and serenity. This class will help you build a strong base and increase awareness in the parts of your body that will support this inversion, especially the core. Don’t be afraid as we approach this challenge, Kino will offer variations so that all levels can experience the meditative stillness of headstand.

programme.title: Yoga, Money & Conscious Living With Sandy Fernandez
programme.desc: Join Kino for a sit-down conversation with Sandy Fernandez, founder of Karmic Currency.

programme.title: Opening the Hips
programme.desc: Join Kino for some yoga drills that will help you work on opening the hips with some external hip rotation. With this video, you will gain a greater understanding of the movement mechanics involved in the action of external hip rotation. Build strength in all the muscles that are involved in opening the hips through this 40-minute practice.

programme.title: Facing Injury in the Practice
programme.desc: When it comes to yoga practice, there's nothing more difficult that facing an injury.

programme.title: Kino in Berlin
programme.desc: Dive into the rich culture, historic wonder and alternative lifestyle of the amazing city of Berlin. If you’ve spent any significant amount of time traveling, you know it can be hard on both your mind and your body. In this episode, you’ll get an inside look at Kino’s morning ritual, which she insists is part of what keeps her grounded amidst all the traveling. Follow Kino around the beautiful city as she teaches to a group of dedicated yogis and gives you an inside look at the city’s tourist sights through the eyes of yoga. Brush up on your Berlin Art and History knowledge as Kino visits the famous TV Tower, The Berlin Wall, one of the city’s last remaining Occupy Buildings, the Berlin Eastside Galleries and more. This episode is just over 20 minutes long.

programme.title: Yoga Is Love
programme.desc: Today's practice is all about love. Start practice by tuning into breath and body, bringing a special attention to the heartspace. Take a moment for feeling into the vibration of the heart, welcoming a feeling of receptivity. Warm yourself up as Kino brings extra attention to opening the chest and front body. Next we segue into finding and loving your particular expression of Gomukhasana, the cow facing posture. Remember that the cow is a sacred symbol of giving and love as you feel into the postures heart opening effects.

programme.title: Utthita Hasta Padangusthasana
programme.desc: This practice starts with breath awareness before moving into a prop supported physical practice. Use a chair to make the challenge of balance work more accessible.

programme.title: Lolasana
programme.desc: This flow uses a chair supported sun salutation to get you started then flows through standing poses before finishing up with some accessible work in the arm balance Lolasana

programme.title: The Pelvic Floor - Forgive
programme.desc: The journey of yoga is a journey of deep intimacy with the body. In this class you will begin to explore the pelvic floor and the concept of forgiveness. Allow the natural intelligence of the inner body to shine cultivate of deep awareness of the intimate, inner space of the body in this 30 minute practice.

programme.title: Plank
programme.desc: Join Kino for a short, gentle practice that is centered around core engagement and the plank pose

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meditation for Kapha
programme.desc: As you’ve learned, Ayurveda recommends different yoga and meditation practices for each of the doshas. In this episode, Sahara Rose will guide you through a meditation that’s designed specifically for Kapha type people.

programme.title: Personal Relationships
programme.desc: Join Kino for a 20 minute meditation on love and tuning into the flow of love in personal relationships. Begin your practice of mindful awareness by feeling the breath. Allow the breath to become an anchor that redirects the mind to the inner experience. Check in with the physical body and the sensations arising there and filtering into awareness. Tap into the energy of the heart and the love that flows there, allow this feeling to spread to all beings and yourself.

programme.title: Yoga Is Unity
programme.desc: The traditional definition of yoga is unity. We will explore this concept through the restorative Pigeon Pose. Begin practice with a reflection on the connection between breath, body and mind. Next, move through a series of long holds in child’s pose, puppy poses and forward folding. Take a supported hip opener using props if you have them handy and then move into another long hold, this time in Pigeon Pose. Take note of any sensations and feelings that arise, offering yourself true care and opening up to a sense of wholeness.

programme.title: Yoga Is Joy
programme.desc: Open your heart to an experience of pure joy. We’ll use Happy Baby pose to explore what yoga truly is. Flow through child’s pose, puppy pose, squats and hip openers before making your way into the sweet release of Happy Baby. No judgement, no fight, no force… use this practice to touch the unscathed, joyful innocence within you.

programme.title: Yoga Is Sanctuary
programme.desc: Today’s lesson is about sanctuary and how to find a place of calm and peace deep within yourself. We’ll use the backbend Ustrasana, or Camel Pose, to dive into that inner world. Kino will guide you through warm ups and then a series of backbends that will challenge you. The idea is to work outside of your comfort zone, just a little, so you seek a source of strength from deep within. As you embrace the challenge you can also embrace a sense of sanctuary and connect to an inner space of faith and grace.

programme.title: Yoga Is Breath
programme.desc: Tune into the truth of who you are underneath the thoughts, using the breath and practice as a means of transformation into true self. This class uses chair pose to explore both physical embodiment and to fuel our inner journey into yoga. Join us for a practice that will bring awareness into your hips and legs, using props to support the postures where needed. Let Kino guide you into a stronger awareness of Agni, the inner fire that burns through impurities and helps the mind see clearer.

Work with understanding your natural completeness, as you explore concepts of attachment and aversion. Find yourself in alignment with faith, breaking the inertia of limiting beliefs and thoughts. Practice towards a state of non attachment, a fertile ground in which to plant the seeds of a happier, more peaceful life.

Shift into a contemplative state, settling the mind below the frequency of thought. Learn to label inner processes in a way that will help you understand the nature of thought and emotion. As the quality of your awareness shifts deeper, Kino will skillfully guide you into a state of contemplation. This practice will help you process emotion and move towards healing and happiness.

programme.title: Backbend - Listen
programme.desc: Join Kino for as class that’s all about backbends and the journey of listening. Begin to tap into the subtle body as you move through this mindful, 25-minute backbending practice. Talk to your muscles and joints and listen to them as you find the strength and flexibility to move through this practice, all while bringing your awareness to various places in the body.

programme.title: Yoga Is Commitment
programme.desc: This class centers around commitment, so Kino is asking you start by going all in. The intention here is to get you on your mat every day, even if you don’t make it through the whole class, so that you can cultivate greater awareness of your body and mind. In this class we’ll build up to a steady, well constructed Down Dog by focusing on the shoulders in a series of preparatory postures. Flow through child's pose, table top, puppy pose and sun salutations as you create healthy patterns of movement and breath control. The commitment you make to the practice is really a statement of your self worth. Join Kino on the mat and say: I am worth it! I am worth these few moments of precious practice.

programme.title: Meditation Now - The Breath
programme.desc: Join Kino for a gentle meditation on the beach by the beautiful shores of Tulum, Mexico. Let go of your thoughts, and experiences as you use the breath to anchor you to the present moment.

programme.title: Meditation Now - The Body
programme.desc: This is a seaside meditation on the peaceful shores of Tulum, Mexico, guided by Kino MacGregor. Bring your awareness to the gift of your body and move deeply into the inner space of this sacred vessel that carries you through this life.

programme.title: Everyday Strength - Build it up
programme.desc: Build up your strength by building a powerful core. Kino guides you through a plank-focused practice that includes side planks, floating planks, and chaturanga (four-limbed staff pose). You'll ignite your inner fire in this short effective class.

programme.title: Standing Postures
programme.desc: Follow Mark as he walks your through techniques that will help you improve your function in standing poses.

programme.title: Yoga Is Discipline
programme.desc: Don’t be intimidated, but today’s lesson is on discipline. This class is all about how to get on your mat with discipline and enjoy it. To find comfort and determination in Navasana Kino will guide you towards just the right amount of front body engagement as well as a helpful awareness in the deep core. Mix your discipline with a fun loving attitude and feel that energy that comes when you rise up to a challenge. Tap into a place of infinite strength within, a place of spiritual fortitude, a strength rooted in the beyond

programme.title: Yoga Is Strength
programme.desc: So much of Kino's personal journey through yoga has been about learning to be strong. That's why shes so excited to share this class that uses plank pose as a bridge to connecting with your own inner reserves. Tune in and learn alignment and articulation in the body that will help you tap into new levels of strength. This sequence will teach you to feel and engage the back body and deep core in ways that support your yoga journey. You’ll finish this practice with a growing sense of stability and strength in both the body and mind.

programme.title: Yoga Inspiration Podcast - On the path
programme.desc: Join Kino and Rob Mack for a discussion about how to use your thoughts to put you on the path to your highest potential. Learn practical steps to help you harness the power of your mind to be happier. Hear Rob’s story about how he struggled with depression and found his way to the joy he experiences now.

programme.desc: Join kino for a conversation about boredom in the yoga practice, what it means, and what you can do about it.

programme.desc: Join Kino for a conversation with David Robson!

programme.desc: Learn the yoga drills you need for powerful shoulders in this class with Kino. A strong core and shoulders are the foundation of arm balances in your practice. Work on plank and navasana (boat pose) drills. You’ll also learn drills for hip flexibility, working toward titibhasana (firefly pose).

programme.title: Tree Pose
programme.desc: A practice that builds up to tree pose. Get rooted into the fundamentals of yoga practice including breath and balance.

programme.title: Yoga Is Balance
programme.desc: This class is about finding balance. Begin with some mindful warmups focused on giving you a sense of embodiment. Explore foundational alignment for balance by feeling the relationship between the pelvis, the central axis of the spine and the rest of the body. Carry that intention of getting acquainted with oneself into today’s focus, the tree pose. Kino will guide you through various modifications, using props where helpful, so that you can find a connection to your own steadiness and vitality.

programme.title: Avocado Fudge Brownies

programme.title: Health
programme.desc: Tune into the breath as an entry way to the present moment. Use this awareness to call your energy back into yourself and cultivate an increasing sense of wellbeing. Feel the sensation of the body and practice acceptance of whatever pleasant or unpleasantness arises. Focus the mind and notice the quality and texture of your thoughts and emotions. Once you settle into practice turn your awareness more fully to the inner experience, planting the seeds of happiness and wellbeing.

programme.title: Everyday Strength - Shoulders and core
programme.desc: Give your strength and confidence a boost when you do this class with Kino. Challenge yourself with floating plank and dolphin plank. Build integrity in the core as you practice navasana (boat pose).

programme.title: Facing Injury in the Practice
programme.desc: When it comes to yoga practice, there's nothing more difficult that facing an injury.

programme.title: Yoga Is Practice
programme.desc: Abhyasa is the sanskrit word for practice. Kino wants to help you find the playful spirit in your heart, even as you commit to practice. Begin the class with breath awareness and some mindful movement. After we warm up we’ll play with forearm plank and leg engagement before moving into the challenge of full Dolphin Pose. Finish class with some reflection on the power of practice and a well earned rest

programme.title: Yoga Is Prayer
programme.desc: Todays class offers an opportunity to understand practice as prayer. Join Kino as she uses Digasana, also known as Warrior 3, as an opportunity to feel the quiet turning inward of the mind. The Warrior postures help you connect to a sense of inner strength. Let Kino guide you through communion with self and you higher power as you flow through a challenging, prop supported balancing sequence.

Bring your attention to the quality of the breath and let this awareness be a bridge into the field of presence. From this place learn to listen for inner guidance and to be receptive to signs that you're on the right path. Anchor yourself in your own inner goodness and let this be a powerful positive reinforcement in your life.

programme.title: Meditation Now - Release Judgment

The crane pose, Bakasana in sanskrit, and other arm balances are a great way to generate energy and prana and bring it up the spine. Today will warm up the core, get the front body activation nice and strong and then find and energetic and equanimous lift up into the posture.

This class uses chair pose to explore both physical embodiment and to fuel our inner journey into yoga. Join us for a practice that will bring awareness into your hips and legs, using props to support the postures where needed. Let Kino guide you into a stronger awareness of Agni, the inner fire that burns through impurities and helps the mind see clearer.

programme.desc: Join Kino and Jessica for a fully loaded conversation that touches on various topics.

Yoga Is Forgiveness
programme.desc: Our asana focus in this class is on a single leg lift known as Utthita Hasta Padangustasana. We’ll us the pose to explore the concept of forgiveness, as this is a very challenging posture and you’ll have to forgive yourself over and over as you learn it. Firm the core and engage the legs as you flow through a warm up. Next, listen in to Kino's expert insights for finding balance in this gateway pose of the Ashtanga method. Remember to go easy on yourself as you struggle to get stable. This quality forgiveness is one of the great lessons of yoga.

programme.title: Shoulders
programme.desc: Build power and foundation with Kino as you join her for more Yoga Drills. This is perfect for those who are looking to build strength and learn strength building techniques. programme.title: Kino in Bali
programme.desc: Come with Kino as she explores magical Bali in the latest installment of Global Yogi. This place is a mecca for yoga, healing, surfing and is known for its welcoming and peaceful Balinese culture. Here it’s common to discover a feeling of being safe and sound, and that was certainly the case for Kino. Green juice, island sand, coconuts and temples… the intoxicating energy of the island spirit can be found around every corner. Days are easily spent relaxing and and enjoying waves and sunsets. Check in for a massage, roll out your mat for practice, chat with the charming locals and find the perfect spot for a quiet meditation… All this and more as Kino continues to bring her message of insight and transformation to the world.

programme.title: Standing Postures

programme.title: Backbend - Listen
programme.desc: Join Kino for as class that’s all about backbends and the journey of listening. Begin to tap into the subtle body as you move through this mindful, 25-minute backbending practice. Talk to your muscles and joints and listen to them as you find the strength and flexibility to move through this practice, all while bringing your awareness to various places in the body.

programme.title: Yoga Is Awakening
programme.desc: Yoga is a path to personal awakening. In today’s lesson we will use the crescent lunge to awaken the energy at the core of your being. Begin with centering breath work and then flow through some warm ups and sun salutations as you bring awareness to the energetic life of the body. Take it nice and easy as you make your way into Anjaneyasana, finding and being at peace with your individual limits in the posture. Kino will guide you into feeling the sensation in the hips and spine, noticing the changes in the body and and letting the practice fuel a sense of awakening.

programme.title: Meditation Now - Cultivate Gratitude
programme.desc: In this meditation with Kino, you will have the opportunity to become mindful of your breath and create peace in your mind. Then settle into the space of your heart to find a deep sense of gratitude for all that is.

programme.title: Sun Salutations
programme.desc: Join Mark for a class that investigates the main movement positions in the traditional Sun Salutations.

programme.title: Yoga Is Love
programme.desc: Today's practice is all about love. Start practice by tuning into breath and body, bringing a special attention to the heartspace. Take a moment for feeling into the vibration of the heart, welcoming a feeling of receptivity. Warm yourself up as Kino brings extra attention to opening the chest and front body. Next we segue into finding and loving your particular expression of Gomukhasana, the cow facing posture. Remember that the cow is a sacred symbol of giving and love as you feel into the postures heart opening effects.

programme.title: Yoga Is Wisdom
programme.desc: When you practice regularly, you create the opportunity for wisdom to arise in you. We will use side plank as the vehicle of awareness that might help us glimpse the truth of any given moment. Warm up with Sun Salutations before moving through several side plank positions that will help bring insight into state of the body and mind. By deepening our ability to turn the attention inward we deepen our ability to touch true wisdom.

programme.title: The Politics of Identity, Inclusivity and Race in the World of Yoga with Kino MacGregor and Dianne Bondy
programme.desc: Join Kino and Dianne Bondy for a conversation about diversity, discrimination, race, identity, and more.

programme.title: Yoga for Inflexible People - Therapeutic Flexibility – Shalabasana
programme.desc: In this class, Kino will focus on a gentle and therapeutic backbend that builds strength and flexibility in the muscles and joints of the spine.

programme.title: Opening the Hips
programme.desc: Join Kino for some yoga drills that will help you work on opening the hips with some external hip rotation. With this video, you will gain a greater understanding of the movement mechanics involved in the action of external hip rotation. Build strength in all the muscles that are involved in opening the hips through this 40-minute practice.

programme.title: Garlic Hummus Mushroom Toast

programme.title: Kino in Berlin
programme.desc: Dive into the rich culture, historic wonder and alternative lifestyle of the amazing city of Berlin. If you’ve spent any significant amount of time traveling, you know it can be hard on both your mind and your body. In this episode, you’ll get an inside look at Kino’s morning ritual, which she insists is part of what keeps her grounded amidst all the traveling. Follow Kino around the beautiful city as she teaches to a group of dedicated yogis and gives you an inside look at the city’s tourist sights through the eyes of yoga. Brush up on your Berlin Art and History knowledge as Kino visits the famous TV Tower, The Berlin Wall, one of the city’s last remaining Occupy Buildings, the Berlin Eastside Galleries and more. This episode is just over 20 minutes long.

programme.title: Shalabhasana
programme.desc: A flow that thoroughly warms up the spine and builds up to the laying backbend called Shalabhasana.

programme.title: Breathe - Freedom

Allow yourself to feel safe and loved through the practice of mindfulness.

Kino will guide you through warm ups and then a series of backbends that will challenge you. The idea is to work outside of your comfort zone, just a little, so you seek a source of strength from deep within. As you embrace the challenge you can also embrace a sense of sanctuary and connect to an inner space of faith and grace.

Kino will teach you the important details of alignment while keeping a focus on not pushing too hard and instead releasing and trusting the process.

After all those handstands and asanas in front of scenic views, we stop for some of local food and to enjoy the local color. Kino's signature sense of humor and storytelling take center stage in this episode, as she delights in sharing San Francisco with you!

programme.desc: Start your meditation practice with a few moments of mindful awareness built around the movement of the breath and the sensations of the body. Work with understanding your natural completeness, as you explore concepts of attachment and aversion. Find yourself in alignment with faith, breaking the inertia of limiting beliefs and thoughts. Practice towards a state of non attachment, a fertile ground in which to plant the seeds of a happier, more peaceful life.

Let Kino guide you through communion with self and you higher power as you flow through a challenging, prop supported balancing sequence.

Kino is here to help you find an experience of the equanimous mind, which is not moved by pleasure or pain. This class will guide you through a series of drills that might induce a state annoyance, so that you have an opportunity to practice returning to calm.
